samples.question: Five panels are stacked vertically and read TOP TO BOTTOM as panel 1, panel 2, panel 3, panel 4, panel 5. Every panel shows the same horizontal track divided into five equal slots, with slot 1 leftmost and slot 5 rightmost. One red token sits in exactly one slot of each panel. The red token is the SAME token in every panel, and between any two consecutive panels it always moves to a DIFFERENT slot. A REVISIT means the token returns, in some panel, to a slot it already occupied in an EARLIER panel (higher in the stack). Reading the panels in order, in which panel does the token FIRST revisit a previous slot? If the token NEVER returns to a slot it used earlier, answer 'never'. Answer 'panel 3', 'panel 4', 'panel 5', or 'never'.
